answer: Admit agents only across one narrow toll-bridge: each epoch auctions a fixed, scarce number of seats by sealed second-price bid. Everyone posts a real deposit, the clearing price comes out crystal clear from the bids, and every winner pays that same price, bonded and forfeit on fraud. Because slot supply is hard-capped, minting N identities means winning N separate seats at the market rate, so a fork gets no volume discount. One honestly bought seat is a pearl; a thousand fakes each pay full fare, pricing sybil swarms off the bridge.
